items.stem: What must be in place before any vulnerability scan of systems you do not own is started?

options.text: Written authorisation defining the scope and timing
options.rationale: Correct: explicit authorisation and scope are required before scanning.

options.text: A public announcement to all internet users
options.rationale: Public announcement is neither required nor sufficient.
The scan is what finds vulnerabilities; this is circular.

options.text: A signed non-disclosure from the vendor of the scanner
options.rationale: A scanner NDA does not authorise scanning the targets.

items.explanation: Correct: explicit authorisation and scope are required before scanning.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which two factors should raise a finding's real-world priority above its raw CVSS base score? (Select TWO)

options.text: A working exploit is publicly available
options.rationale: Correct: available exploits increase likelihood of attack.
Correct: exposure increases the attack surface and likelihood.

options.text: The finding has a memorable CVE identifier
options.rationale: The identifier's memorability has no bearing on risk.

options.text: The scanner used a blue icon for the result
options.rationale: Icon colour is cosmetic and irrelevant to risk.

items.explanation: Correct: available exploits increase likelihood of attack.; Correct: exposure increases the attack surface and likelihood.

items.stem: Why is an authenticated scan usually more accurate for assessing missing patches than an unauthenticated one?

options.text: It can read installed versions and configuration directly on the host
options.rationale: Correct: credentials let the scanner inspect actual patch levels instead of inferring them.

options.text: It never produces any false positives
options.rationale: Authenticated scans can still produce false positives.
Authorisation is still required regardless of scan type.

options.text: It automatically fixes the vulnerabilities it finds
options.rationale: Scanning assesses; it does not remediate.

items.explanation: Correct: credentials let the scanner inspect actual patch levels instead of inferring them.
